summary_1line: After Rama’s followers attain heaven, the text concludes by praising the Ramayana’s spiritual merit and blessings for those who hear or recite it.

image_candidates.scene_text: Devotees step into the waters of the Sarayu River and their bodies transform into radiant forms rising in celestial chariots toward heaven.
Brahma and the assembled gods watch as monkeys, bears, and warriors enter the sacred river and ascend to the heavens in glowing bodies.
In heaven, Vishnu speaks to Brahma while hosts of gods, sages, and celestial beings listen amid radiant light.
